name: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle
summary: At Southshore's inn, Lieutenant Farren Orinelle drinks and leaves his duties to others. He resents his posting in the Hillsbrad Foothills and hopes for a transfer south. Marshal Redpath has assigned him to deal with the murlocs along the coast.

sections.title: Exile in Southshore
sections.body: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle spends his days at Southshore's inn, far from the Stormwind he prefers. Sent north from Stormwind City, he finds the contested shores of Hillsbrad a poor fit. Rather than patrol the fields or coordinate defenses with Marshal Redpath, he drinks, grumbles, and waits for an order transferring him south.

sections.title: Outsourcing Duty
sections.body: Marshal Redpath has tasked Lieutenant Farren Orinelle with clearing murlocs from the nearby shoreline. Orinelle leaves the muddy coast to passing travelers, asking them to kill the creatures and bring proof. He hopes the results will satisfy his superiors and hasten his return to Stormwind.

faq.answer: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle is a Stormwind officer stationed in Southshore, in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He drinks at the inn and grumbles about his posting.
He was transferred north from Stormwind City to support Marshal Redpath and the local garrison. Orinelle dislikes the assignment and wants to return home.
Marshal Redpath ordered Orinelle to deal with the hostile murlocs along the Hillsbrad coast. Orinelle prefers to pay travelers to fight them.

faq.q: Does he ever leave the Southshore inn?
faq.answer: Orinelle spends almost all his time at the Southshore inn, reluctant to face the muddy beaches or hostile elements outside.
Orinelle wants an official reassignment to Stormwind City, away from Lordaeron's coast.
Orinelle reports to Marshal Redpath, who commands the Alliance detachment defending Southshore.

angles.text: For Alliance champions, Orinelle is a disgruntled southern soldier at a lonely northern outpost, willing to offer coin and commendation to anyone who takes on his duties.
Orinelle is a Stormwind soldier far from Elwynn Forest. His disdain for northern frontier duty shows the divide between comfortable capital life and harsh overseas deployments.
